Apple's operating income fell about 24.3% from fiscal Q1 2025 to fiscal Q4 2025.

- **Fiscal Q1 2025** (three months ended December 28, 2024): operating income was $42,832 million.
- **Fiscal Q4 2025:** the excerpts give no standalone figure. I derived it as full-year fiscal 2025 operating income of $133,050 million minus the nine-month figure of $100,623 million (nine months ended June 28, 2025), which is $32,427 million.

The change is ($32,427 − $42,832) / $42,832 = −$10,405 / $42,832 ≈ −24.3%.
